notablePrerequisites: You have at least five permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {3}{G}{G}, creating a creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
